name: Band Assisted Muscle-Up
how_to:
1. Loop a resistance band securely over a pull-up bar and place your feet or knees in the band.
2. Grip the bar firmly with hands slightly wider than shoulder-width, using a false grip if possible.
3. Engage your core and initiate a powerful pull-up with speed toward the bar.
4. As your chest nears the bar, lean forward and drive your elbows over to transition.
5. Press up into a dip position until your arms are fully extended.
6. Lower yourself slowly, returning through the dip and pull-up phase. Repeat.
